textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 science · Beyond Earth · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Stars are huge balls of hot gas that give out their own light. The Sun is a star, the nearest one to us. Stars look tiny because they are very far away.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Stars are huge balls of hot gas that give out their own light. The Sun is a star, the nearest one to us. Stars look tiny because they are very far away. Constellations have recognisable star patterns.
beats.speakEn: Stars are huge balls of hot gas that give out their own light. The Sun is a star, the nearest one to us. Stars look tiny because they are very far away. Constellations have recognisable star patterns.

beats.en: Over one night, most stars seem to cross the sky because Earth spins. Earth turns beneath the changing view. Planets in our sky reflect sunlight.
beats.speakEn: Over one night, most stars seem to cross the sky because Earth spins. Earth turns beneath the changing view. Planets in our sky reflect sunlight.

type: Key Concept: Stars are huge balls of hot gas that give out their own light.
Rule: Over one night, most stars seem to cross the sky because Earth spins.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 science · Beyond Earth · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The solar system is the Sun with the planets and other objects that go around it. The eight planets in order from the Sun are Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.

beats.en: The solar system is the Sun with the planets and other objects that go around it. The eight planets in order from the Sun are Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.
beats.speakEn: The solar system is the Sun with the planets and other objects that go around it. The eight planets in order from the Sun are Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.

beats.en: Our solar system is part of a huge galaxy of stars called the Milky Way. There are billions of galaxies in the universe, and the universe is vast beyond imagination.
beats.speakEn: Our solar system is part of a huge galaxy of stars called the Milky Way. There are billions of galaxies in the universe, and the universe is vast beyond imagination.
